speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: You've gone quiet.
spoken_text: You've gone quiet.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: I'm listening for the birds.
spoken_text: I'm listening for the birds.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: How do I trip without feet?
spoken_text: How do I trip without feet?

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: You're finding new ways.
spoken_text: You're finding new ways.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Is this body holding together?
spoken_text: Is this body holding together?

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: Yes. I'd tell you if it wasn't.
spoken_text: Yes. I'd tell you if it wasn't.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: There. A little less wind.
spoken_text: There. A little less wind.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: You noticed I was cold?
spoken_text: You noticed I was cold?

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Did you see that?
spoken_text: Did you see that?

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: Even the part you meant to do.
spoken_text: Even the part you meant to do.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: You're leaving your right side open.
spoken_text: You're leaving your right side open.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Remind me before the next one.
spoken_text: Remind me before the next one.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Aren't slimes meant to be harmless?
spoken_text: Aren't slimes meant to be harmless?

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: You've met the local slimes.
spoken_text: You've met the local slimes.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: That fire almost feels warm.
spoken_text: That fire almost feels warm.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: Then stay a moment.
spoken_text: Then stay a moment.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: You're following every sound again.
spoken_text: You're following every sound again.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: One of them might be someone.
spoken_text: One of them might be someone.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Do you ever get lost?
spoken_text: Do you ever get lost?

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: I would call it gathering information.
spoken_text: I would call it gathering information.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: How are you always so calm?
spoken_text: How are you always so calm?

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: One of us has to be.
spoken_text: One of us has to be.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: The ground is firmer on the left.
spoken_text: The ground is firmer on the left.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Thanks. I'm tired of sinking.
spoken_text: Thanks. I'm tired of sinking.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: I almost had that one.
spoken_text: I almost had that one.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: You did have it. Give yourself that much.
spoken_text: You did have it. Give yourself that much.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: Wait. Listen before we move.
spoken_text: Wait. Listen before we move.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Right. Quiet doesn't always mean safe.
spoken_text: Right. Quiet doesn't always mean safe.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Remind me never to sit down here.
spoken_text: Remind me never to sit down here.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: I was about to.
spoken_text: I was about to.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: The boat is still there.
spoken_text: The boat is still there.

speaker: RAINORAY
text: Good. I like knowing we can go back.
spoken_text: Good. I like knowing we can go back.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: Easy. Give yourself a little room.
spoken_text: Easy. Give yourself a little room.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: That one hurt. Step back.
spoken_text: That one hurt. Step back.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: I'm here. Keep moving.
spoken_text: I'm here. Keep moving.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: Watch your footing.
spoken_text: Watch your footing.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: Don't rush the next move.
spoken_text: Don't rush the next move.

speaker: INNER_VOICE
text: You're still in this.
spoken_text: You're still in this.

speaker: WARDEN
text: Stand down.
spoken_text: Stand down.

speaker: WARDEN
text: Hold the line.
spoken_text: Hold the line.

speaker: WARDEN
text: The gate stays shut.
spoken_text: The gate stays shut.

speaker: WARDEN
text: I was ordered to protect them.
spoken_text: I was ordered to protect them.

speaker: WARDEN
text: CONTAMINATED LIFEFORM. PASSAGE DENIED.
spoken_text: Contaminated lifeform. passage denied.

speaker: WARDEN
text: THE ROAD IS SEALED FOR THEIR PROTECTION.
spoken_text: The road is sealed for their protection.

speaker: TOBIN
text: Who's there? If you're a rift thing, I'm mostly bandages. Poor eating.
spoken_text: Who's there? If you're a rift thing, I'm mostly bandages. Poor eating.

speaker: TOBIN
text: Kaijin. I worked on the gate relay. That sound means the Warden's still running a broken order.
spoken_text: Kaijin. I worked on the gate relay. That sound means the Warden's still running a broken order.

speaker: TOBIN
text: The fence came down behind me. I couldn't climb it with this leg.
spoken_text: The fence came down behind me. I couldn't climb it with this leg.

speaker: TOBIN
text: For a lamp? I'll crawl. Thank you.
spoken_text: For a lamp? I'll crawl. Thank you.

speaker: ILSE
text: Stay back. I've got one good arm and I'm not afraid to use it.
spoken_text: Stay back. I've got one good arm and I'm not afraid to use it.

speaker: ILSE
text: Eren. I was scouting the road. Those roots moved against the wind, then closed behind me.
spoken_text: Eren. I was scouting the road. Those roots moved against the wind, then closed behind me.

speaker: ILSE
text: That chest holds our spare supplies. Locked tight, and the key went with the storehouse.
spoken_text: That chest holds our spare supplies. Locked tight, and the key went with the storehouse.

speaker: ILSE
text: Watch the roots when the wind stops. They don't stop with it.
spoken_text: Watch the roots when the wind stops. They don't stop with it.

speaker: SEDGE
text: Watch the bank. Looks solid until you put a foot on it.
spoken_text: Watch the bank. Looks solid until you put a foot on it.

speaker: SEDGE
text: I got them across before the roots took the river. The injured are sheltering beneath the old stair.
spoken_text: I got them across before the roots took the river. The injured are sheltering beneath the old stair.

speaker: SEDGE
text: Souei. I marked a path back, but the roots keep closing it.
spoken_text: Souei. I marked a path back, but the roots keep closing it.

speaker: SEDGE
text: Then they have somewhere safe to go. Follow the white cloth north, then east over the ford.
spoken_text: Then they have somewhere safe to go. Follow the white cloth north, then east over the ford.

speaker: SEDGE
text: I'll guard their crossing. You reach the tree. Watch the ground; it reaches farther than its branches.
spoken_text: I'll guard their crossing. You reach the tree. Watch the ground; it reaches farther than its branches.

speaker: SEDGE
text: White cloth through the grove, then east across the dry ford. The stair is beyond the thorn clearing.
spoken_text: White cloth through the grove, then east across the dry ford. The stair is beyond the thorn clearing.

speaker: SEDGE
text: The rope is ready. Clear the roots and I'll bring them through.
spoken_text: The rope is ready. Clear the roots and I'll bring them through.

speaker: SEDGE
text: The roots went slack. I thought the whole bank was falling.
spoken_text: The roots went slack. I thought the whole bank was falling.

speaker: SEDGE
text: Under the old stair. I'm Souei. I've been guarding their route back. We can move them now.
spoken_text: Under the old stair. I'm Souei. I've been guarding their route back. We can move them now.

speaker: SEDGE
text: The white cloth's moving again. There hasn't been a breeze through here in days.
spoken_text: The white cloth's moving again. There hasn't been a breeze through here in days.

speaker: SEDGE
text: I'll bring a stretcher. You see who's still down there.
spoken_text: I'll bring a stretcher. You see who's still down there.

speaker: SEDGE
text: Everyone we found. They're at the camp.
spoken_text: Everyone we found. They're at the camp.
